name: SnapDance
tagline: A Snapchat lens that scores your dance against a reference in real time with full-body tracking.

awards: Best use of Snap Lens Studio

problem: Dance games need consoles; phones are everywhere.
solution: Tracks 18 body landmarks in a Snapchat lens and scores the user against reference videos.
demo_moment: Team-described: dance head-to-head and see the score.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Snap Lens Studio” and “Entertainment” among 212 submissions.
Turns a social app into a game platform.

lessons: Ride a platform players already have open.
